findings.body:
chunk 1/2:

Item 12 remains incomplete in this part. The board still derives the old counts here and renders the old card page; blocking plan problems are absent from Needs you, and the pane still uses abbreviated times. The story assigns these behaviors to COUNTS, WAITS, NAV and PANE.
findings.title: Later: COUNTS, WAITS, NAV and PANE complete item 12

findings.body:
chunk 2/2:

Raise: Functional. On a repeat close with a default-branch conflict, this call publishes a fabricated running review with empty findings and evidence. `_publish` replaces the existing managed block, so a blocked review loses its findings and proof list and appears to be running after close has stopped.
findings.title: A merge conflict erases the pull request's review findings and proof

findings.body:
chunk 2/2:

Raise: Functional. The board passes part and read intervals plus the story's start to `time_records.story`, but supplies no completion bound when the story is done. If `forge story done` records an outcome hours after the last part merges, that interval is absent from the story's unknown seconds and total. The added runway test covers an unfinished story only.
findings.title: Completed stories omit elapsed time after their last part

findings.body:
chunk 2/2:

Item 12 remains incomplete here: the board retains its old counts and card page, blocking plan problems are absent from Needs you, and pane times remain abbreviated. The pinned folding sections, story keys and cold-read history are also absent. The story assigns these behaviors to COUNTS, WAITS, NAV and PANE.
findings.title: Later: COUNTS, WAITS, NAV and PANE complete item 12

stop.reason: Owner rule for Harm 1-2: the record-shape finding is fixed in commit 55413144b (any error reading a PR's time record counts as no record); the merge-conflict republish and done-story time findings were accepted earlier as follow-ups
